name: PURITA Phuket Bangtao
shortDescription: PURITA Phuket Bangtao is a new condominium by CG Capital, the investment arm of the family behind Central Group, on a 10-rai plot in Cherngtalay.
description: PURITA Phuket Bangtao is a new condominium by CG Capital, the investment arm of the family behind Central Group, on a 10-rai plot in Cherngtalay. It has four six-storey buildings and one villa around a courtyard garden with a 50-metre pool, with 258 furnished units in total. Apartments are one-bedroom, two-bedroom and two-bedroom-plus types from 56.4 to 136 sqm. Completion is announced for November 2028.
furniture: Fully furnished with kitchen, built-in wardrobes, furniture and appliances
facilities: Changing rooms with private steam rooms
One year of concierge service included

researchNotes: Identity: official name is PURITA Phuket Bangtao (supplied 'PURITA Phuket'). Developer CG Capital confirmed by press release coverage. puritaphuket.com appears to be a sales/marketing site (price list, 3D model) rather than the developer's own site; price list data attributed there to the developer. Only buildings A and C are in the first price list (79 units, 19 shown available); buildings B, D and the 708 sqm villa (built-up vs land area not stated) are not yet priced. 1BR units are leasehold except 6th floor of building C (freehold); 2BR and 2BR+ freehold, 93 sqm 2BR under foreign quota. Bathrooms, exact coordinates and bedroom count of villa not found. Launch press release gives THB 7.29M start and a VIP event on 29 Nov; BURO/Keller Henson built-up ranges differ (Keller Henson 58-124 sqm). Land title: 10-0-72.3 rai (16,289 sqm). Images are developer visualisations; final design may differ. Beach distance is 1.5 km (site) vs 1.3 km / 2.3 km on portals. | Lowest unit price in the 12 Nov 2026 price list shown at puritaphuket.com is THB 7,997,000 (56.4 sqm 1BR, leasehold). The same page also quotes 'from THB 7.87 million' and 'from 8M'; a launch press release says from THB 7.29 million; BURO says from 7.87M; Keller Henson 10.65M. Per-unit discounts of THB 300,000 (1BR) to 800,000 (2BR+) are shown. Launch prices valid until 28 Nov 2026.
